author: The Q
description:
I’ve always wanted a smarter home, and at IFA 2026, Midea showed me a very different approach. From SMART MASTER and AI-powered energy management with EcoMaster to SpaceMaster, smart kitchen, air treatment and laundry solutions, I explored how Midea is connecting individual appliances into one intelligent system. I also checked out the Built-in Series, TEKA, Küppersbusch and the FC Barcelona partnership.

👉 midea.com

#Midea #MidealFA2026 #IFA2026 #Simplyldeal
title: Midea Just Built the Smart Home I Wanted | IFA 2026 Berlin
